name: composio
description: Lets the assistant use the user's other apps (Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, HubSpot, Linear and 1000+ more) through Composio Connect, Composio's hosted MCP server. One browser sign-in to Composio connects it; each app is then connected on first use by a Composio sign-in link, with no API keys anywhere.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary:
Lets the assistant work with your other apps on your behalf: Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, HubSpot and over a thousand more.

You sign in to Composio once in your browser. After that, the first time the assistant needs a new app, it gives you a link to connect it. Nothing to copy or paste.
